title: Record audio from any app on macOS
excerpt: Seamlessly isolate and capture per-app audio—Spotify, Zoom, Safari, Discord, or Logic and other apps straight into MP3 or high-efficiency AAC files with zero latency.
content_html:
Seamlessly isolate and capture per-app audio—Spotify, Zoom, Safari, Discord, or Logic and other apps straight into MP3 or high-efficiency AAC files with zero latency.

Per-App Audio Capture

Isolate individual application streams without capture bleed from background notifications or other apps.

Zero-Latency Engine

Built natively for Apple Silicon & Intel Macs, capturing audio instantly with negligible CPU usage.

Multiple Export Formats

Save directly to pristine MP3 or AAC audio formats configured to your preferred bitrates.

Automatic Timed Recording

Coming Soon

Schedule audio recordings and set auto-stop timers with ease.

Private & Local First

Your audio never leaves your machine. All processing happens 100% locally on your Mac for total privacy.

More Features

Coming Soon

We are constantly building new audio capabilities. Stay tuned for upcoming tools and power features.
